title: 2D Game Developer (Defold) (Remote-Worldwide)
description:
This job is with our partner Micro1.

Scope of Work

  • Develop and modify 2D games using the Defold game engine.

  • Work with Lua scripting, game objects, components, and animations.

  • Create and improve game mechanics, player controls, and UI elements.

  • Debug issues and optimize game performance.

  • Complete advanced game development tasks and explain your workflow step by step.

  • Create clear instructions and detailed prompts for game development tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong professional experience using the Defold game engine.

  • Hands-on experience with Lua scripting and 2D game development.

  • Good understanding of Defold game objects, components, animations, and game logic.

  • Access to Defold and ability to record your screen while completing tasks.

  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher.

  • Ability to explain technical workflows clearly.
